description: Optional bounded source projection. Omit this object for relationship-only structural context. For source-bearing implementation or ownership analysis, use PROJECTED with INCLUDE and FULL_DEFINITION.

mode.description: TARGET returns only the target definition; PROJECTED returns selected endpoint definitions and exact server-reported relation occurrences; COMPLETE_CAPTURE additionally permits explicitly selected ancillary source.

body.description: INCLUDE returns source bodies for selected full display ranges; OMIT returns metadata, ranges, custody, privacy, and accounting without source bodies.

include_relation_occurrences.description: Include exact server-reported call-site occurrences and their containing caller definitions when selected by the projection mode.

include_ancillary.description: Include eligible ancillary source only when explicitly requested; normally false for implementation analysis.

display_range_policy.description: Resolve complete definition display ranges from server-reported textDocument/documentSymbol while preserving exact evidence, item, selection, and call-site ranges independently.

limits.description: Independent hard projection and document-acquisition bounds. A practical bounded starting point is objects/ranges 80, source bytes 2097152, work 10000, response bytes 8388608, additional documents 20, document requests 21, document bytes 1048576, total document bytes 8388608, document messages 32, acquisition work 21, and display-resolution work 21.

max_document_requests.description: Maximum managed document preparation requests including the target.

max_document_bytes.description: Maximum bytes admitted for each prepared document.

max_total_document_bytes.description: Maximum total bytes admitted across prepared documents.

max_document_messages.description: Maximum protocol messages consumed by each document preparation.

max_display_resolution_work.description: Maximum server-reported document-symbol display-resolution work units.

privacy_policy_id.description: Caller-selected projection privacy policy identifier; use only a policy recognized by the executing host.
